name: Kaioken Graph
summary: Structural module for kaioken/graph, building, persisting, and rendering a knowledge graph that links repository source files to documentation chapters, sections, cards, and skills via provenance, claims, and import relationships.
keyPoints: GRAPH_ARTIFACT is defined as join(KAIOKEN_DIR, 'graph.json') and functions graphPath, writeGraph, readGraph manage reading/writing the graph JSON artifact relative to a root directory.
writeExportTree writes a bundle of files under subdirectories cards/, wiki/, skills/ and returns the written paths, using safeJoin to prevent path traversal.

buildGraph constructs a KnowledgeGraph from GraphBuildInput, and buildCodeGraph builds a code-level graph; node kinds are derived from document IDs via nodeKindFor and splitDocumentId, with edge kinds distinguishing written_from, shared_source, references, imports, and reexports.
render.ts provides multiple rendering targets: renderGraphMarkdown, renderGraphMermaid, toD3Graph, toCytoscapeGraph, and exportGraphJson; renderMermaid and renderGraphJson are aliases.
assertGraphIntegrity validates the graph structure before use, and graphStats computes coverage statistics including isolated nodes and coverage percentage.
Type definitions in types.ts define NodeKind, GraphNode, EdgeKind, GraphEdge, KnowledgeGraph, GraphStats, and input/output shapes (GraphBuildInput, CodeGraphInput, D3Graph, CytoscapeGraph).

entryPoints.name: buildGraph
entryPoints.note: Main entry to construct a KnowledgeGraph from provenance, claims, and skill inputs.

entryPoints.name: writeGraph
entryPoints.note: Persists a KnowledgeGraph to graph.json under the given root.

entryPoints.name: readGraph
entryPoints.note: Loads a KnowledgeGraph from graph.json, returning null if absent.

entryPoints.name: renderGraphMarkdown
entryPoints.note: Renders the graph as human-readable markdown, typically with stats.

entryPoints.name: renderGraphMermaid
entryPoints.note: Renders the graph as a Mermaid diagram with clustering and labels.

entryPoints.name: exportGraphJson
entryPoints.note: Exports the graph to D3 or Cytoscape JSON format.

entryPoints.name: graphStats
entryPoints.note: Computes node/edge counts, coverage, and isolated nodes with optional scan paths.
